findings.message: the pattern matches 6 of 8 sample lines. It must match every one: a line it misses is dropped entirely, not partly parsed. The first it misses is 'Oct 22 08:44:30 imap-login: Info: Login aborted: Connection closed (auth failed, 1 attempts in 9 secs) (auth_failed): user=<nuno>, method=PLAIN, rip=172.21.0.3,'. the pattern matches up to %{DATA:user}, which fails on 'Info: Login aborted: Connection closed (' It also misses lines of other shapes: 'Oct 22 08:44:42 imap-login: Info: Login aborted: Connection closed (auth failed, 1 attempts in 4 secs) (auth_failed): user=<root>, method=PL'. If this line is a VARIANT of the others - an extra word, a field that is sometimes absent - make that part optional with (?:...)? rather than writing a second pattern. If it is a DIFFERENT KIND of message - different words, not one more of them - add a pattern for it to `alternatives`, reusing the same capture name for the same value.
'secs' appears in 8/8 samples but is neither mapped nor listed as unresolved.
